localChanges: Under Despotism and Anarchy, a square that yields more than 2 food, shields or trade now gives 1 less of it, as in the original. A city celebrating "We Love the King Day" is spared, and under Monarchy or Communism a celebrating city's squares that produce trade get 1 more, as they do under The Republic (closes #401).

Special resources, mines and irrigation now give the original's yields under every government: Gold gives 6 trade, Gems 4, an Oasis 3 food and Oil 4 shields, while Coal, Seals and a mine on Desert or Mountains give 1 less than before under Monarchy and up. Under The Republic and Democracy every square that produces trade gets 1 more, Gold and Gems included.
When a city is destroyed, its square no longer goes on showing the irrigation it lost.
